title: Reset a User's OTP Credential in Keycloak
about: A real task in Keycloak 26.8.2, filmed in the browser in the tested order: find the user, sign them out, require a new authenticator, delete the lost one, the user's own setup, and the check. Captioned, without a voice.
where: Recorded on Keycloak 26.8.2, open-source software, with a test realm and test users
